player_prompt.intro:
Am ̣ōm Player {player_id} Checkers khelām {color} hisāb se khelatam.
Apni gativādī chess-style notation meṃ likhām [fileRank fileRank], udāharaṇa '[b2c3]' (kholam akṣara a–h, ṭhahar digit 0–7).
Mūlak āṅgā:
  • Ṭhikāne khālī ṭhām ṭhikāne 1 ḍhāpe diagonal aage jāo.
  • Biṛōdhī ke piece ke upar se jhāmp karke dhabo.
  • Ek piece ulṭā pārām ṭhām pahuṅc ke Rājā bane jāe.
